newsitem.title: USA: Alpha Micro sells AlphaHealthCare unit.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Micro sells AlphaHealthCare unit.

text.p: Alpha Microsystems said Tuesday it had sold its AlphaHealthCare unit to UNIDENT Practice Performance Systems for $450,000 plus contingency payments over a five-year period.
Oregon-based AlphaHealthCare provides dental practice management products.
Alpha Micro said the sale is not expected to have a material impact on its fiscal fourth quarter, ending February 23.
UNIDENT, based in Lincoln, Neb., is a privately-held seller of technology solutions for the dental market.

"The sale of AlphaHealthCare marks a concluding step in our divestiture efforts and allows us to more clearly focus our resources on the AlphaCONNECT family of Internet/intranet products and the North American services operation," Alpha Micro Chief Executive Officer Douglas Tullio said in a statement.
"We anticipate that the sale of AlphaHealthCare will also help improve the bottom-line performance of Alpha Microsystems," he said.
